### Reference: outcomes: done, invalid input, failed, paused, cancelled, undo

#### `ResultBlock`

const, type · `import { ResultBlock } from '@harness/sdk'`

The result block: everything the model needs to talk about rows the person is shown.

```ts
type ResultBlock = {
  shown: string;
  columns: {
    nullable: boolean;
    name: string;
    kind: "number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary";
  }[];
  rowCount: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  sort: {
    column: string;
    dir: "asc" | "desc";
  }[];
  sample: Record<string, z.core.util.JSONType>[];
  fn: {
    name: string;
    signature: string;
  };
  total?: number | undefined;
  nextPage?: {
    offset: number;
    limit: number;
    call: string;
  } | undefined;
  sampleNote?: string | undefined;
};
```

Refers to: [`Json`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-json), [`ResultSort`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.registries-ts#core-resultsort).

#### `ResultBlockOptions`

interface · `import { ResultBlockOptions } from '@harness/sdk/server'`

What `resultBlock` needs besides the rows.

```ts
interface ResultBlockOptions {
  /** The fn that read the rows, and its signature, to call it again. */
  readonly fn: ResultFn;
  /** The args it was called with; the next page's call is these with the next `offset` and `limit`. */
  readonly args?: Readonly<Record<string, Json>>;
  /** What the person sees the rows as (default `a table`), for the sentence the model reads. */
  readonly visual?: string;
  /** The sample's token budget. Default: `HARNESS_RESULT_SAMPLE_TOKENS`. */
  readonly budget?: number;
  /** The most characters of one text cell in the sample. Default: `HARNESS_RESULT_CELL_CHARS`. */
  readonly cellChars?: number;
  /** Whether a person is watching the run (`RunInfo.watched === true`), so the rows are shown to them. Default true. */
  readonly watched?: boolean;
}
```

Refers to: [`Json`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-json).

#### `Outcome`

type · `import { Outcome } from '@harness/sdk'`

How a run ended. Build it with the ctx helpers (`ctx.done(result)`, `ctx.invalid(problems)`, `ctx.fail(...)`,
`ctx.pause(state)`, `ctx.cancelled()`), which are typed to the fn. Its wire form is core's `OutcomeWire`.
`invalid-input` is the caller's mistake (an agent retries it, the chat shows it softly); `failed` is a real error.

```ts
type Outcome<T extends FnTypes> =
| { status: 'done'; result: T['result']; undo?: T['undo']; cost?: Usd }
| { status: 'invalid-input'; invalid: InvalidInput; cost?: Usd }
| { status: 'paused'; resume: T['resume']; cost?: Usd }
| { status: 'failed'; error: FnError; undo?: T['undo']; cost?: Usd }
| { status: 'cancelled'; partial?: T['result']; undo?: T['undo']; cost?: Usd };
```

Refers to: [`FnError`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.run-ts#core-fnerror), [`InvalidInput`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.run-ts#core-invalidinput), [`Usd`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-usd).

interface · `import { Resume } from '@harness/sdk'`

What a resuming run receives.

```ts
interface Resume<S> {
  readonly state: S;
  /** Results of calls that finished, by call key, so they aren't made again. */
  readonly calls: Readonly<Record<string, Settled<Json>>>;

}
```
